evidence: The task is authored for a specific legal product: instruction.md:1-3 is a law-firm client voice ('Kittle & Rowe is a small law firm...') whose two stated priorities are ethical walls and retention with legal hold; walls-and-retention.md:57-79 defines matter-level walls (Dev walled from M-12, live wall add/lift by a partner), disappearing-message timers off/1/7/30 days against a fixed clock with exact-boundary deletion, partner-only legal holds that override timers, and matter transcripts. The graded set follows that domain: functional ids wall_every_route, wall_mentions_and_links, wall_added_live, deleted_and_expired_messages, timer_changes, hold_scope_and_release, search_and_transcript carry most of the weight (task-specific weight comment: 'Core legal behaviour (walls, retention, holds, persistence) is 2.0'), and visual ids matter_sidebar, retention_marks, transcript_page, phone_chambers are product-specific. Seed keys (firm, accounts, matters with timers M-11/M-12/M-13, read_up_to) match this shape; no residue from other products found in brief, notes, prompts, app_context or golden (grep for threadline/channel/workspace/webhook/reaction/candidate hits only template boilerplate 'empty workspace', present identically in the frozen template prompt.md:9, and a code variable 'candidate' in server.js). The only sibling in the same domain, projects/threadline-chat, is a generic Slack-style team chat (channels, DMs, reactions, pins, presence/typing, incoming webhooks with exact routes, append-only audit, moderators); none of walls, timers, holds, transcripts or matter scoping appears there, and Kittle has no reactions, pins, DMs, presence or webhooks. Shared primitives (replies, mentions, unread, edits, message links, idempotent send, live updates) are inherent to the 'Messaging & Chat Interfaces' category and are re-specified in Kittle with legal twists (stale-edit refusal, mention suggestions limited to non-walled viewers, link previews showing 'not available' across walls, unread hidden for walled matters). Clone test: renaming Threadline's channels to matters would satisfy none of the wall/timer/hold/transcript criteria; a conforming Kittle app would fail Threadline's reaction/pin/webhook/presence criteria, so the flows and criteria are not interchangeable. Category 'Messaging & Chat Interfaces' matches the build-context plan (KITTLE_BUILD_CONTEXT.txt:12). No runtime evidence is required for this authorship row.
